Package Models.BehaviourStrategies

Class BenevolentStrategyTest

  • java.lang.Object
    • Models.BehaviourStrategies.BenevolentStrategyTest
  • @TestInstance(PER_CLASS)
public class BenevolentStrategyTest
extends java.lang.Object
    Unit tests for the BenevolentStrategy class, which represents the benevolent behavior strategy for a player in the game. The tests cover the creation of deploy and advance orders based on the specific strategy rules.
